summary: Curry County, OR site on the Siskiyou National Forest, about 25 miles southeast of Port Orford. Called abandoned by Fire Lookout.com and gone by FFLA; no build details found.

facts.status_note: The Forest Fire Lookout Association lists the site as gone; Fire Lookout.com says only abandoned

evidence.supports: lookout site on the Siskiyou National Forest
about 25 miles southeast of Port Orford
only date is the 1930s, with no detail; site abandoned
association places the site at 42.51827, -124.09936 with unknown type and gone status

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Fire Lookout.com says abandoned. The Forest Fire Lookout Association says gone. The record keeps gone, because that association is the only source that gives a status beyond abandoned. Neither listing says what gone covers for the structure.

notes_for_editor: Two short listings only; no build date, builder, design or staffing in any source read. A separate record, Pebble Hill (west_us_lookouts source, about 42.5133, -124.0998), sits roughly half a kilometre from these coordinates. The Forest Lookouts Pebble Hill page (oregonlookouts.weebly.com) names Siskiyou National Forest 35S-12W-26 and is a different name. Nothing read links the two, so they were not merged; check before combining.
